message.content: the delivery retries contract in nebulamail changed, so mail queue consumers need a compatibility shim
profiling nebulamail showed that mail queue spends most cycles inside backlog serialization
a stale delivery retries entry in nebulamail can shadow mail queue for minutes unless the ttl is low
the runbook for idempotency keys in nebulamail says to drain delivery retries before restarting the daemon
under load, nebulamail keeps consumer blocking latency flat while slow query becomes the real bottleneck
when debugging consumer blocking in nebulamail, start from the backlog logs and walk the call chain
